evidence.title: README (segment 2)
evidence.excerpt: A cryptocurrency trading API with more than 100 exchanges in JavaScript / TypeScript / Python / C# / PHP / Go.

evidence.title: README (segment 4)
evidence.excerpt: The **CCXT** library is used to connect and trade with cryptocurrency exchanges and payment processing services worldwide. It provides quick access to market data for storage, analysis, visualization, indicator development, algorithmic trading, strategy backtesting, bot programming, and related software engineering.

evidence.title: README (segment 5)
evidence.excerpt: It is intended to be used by **coders, developers, technically-skilled traders, data-scientists and financial analysts** for building trading algorithms.

evidence.title: README (segment 6)
evidence.excerpt: - support for many cryptocurrency exchanges — more coming soon - fully implemented public and private APIs - optional normalized data for cross-exchange analytics and arbitrage - an out of the box unified API that is extremely easy to integrate - works in Node 10.4+, Python 3, PHP 8.1+, netstandard2.0/2.1, Go 1.20+ and web browsers
